visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of female hands enters the frame, cracking a brown egg against the edge of a white ceramic bowl on a wooden countertop. Two more eggs follow in sequence. The setting is a bright, clean kitchen. Subtitles at the top mention cast iron pan seasoning. (2) The hands use wooden chopsticks to beat the eggs rapidly in the bowl. In the background, a light blue cast iron pot sits on a black induction cooktop. The lighting is soft and professional. Text explains the number of eggs used for this recipe. (3) On a yellow cutting board, the person uses a chef's knife to finely chop green scallions into rings. The background shows kitchen jars with utensils. Text overlays describe the scallion amount. The camera is in a close-up on the cutting action. (4) Chopped scallions are added to the eggs in the bowl with a pinch of salt. The person stirs the mixture thoroughly with a wooden spoon. The camera angle is a medium close-up. Text indicates adding seasoning to the bowl before mixing. (5) The focus shifts to the blue pan on the induction stove. A hand presses buttons on the digital panel, causing interface lights to flash. The narrator explains preheating. Text confirms the 'oil film seasoning stage' has begun in the studio environment. (6) Oil is poured into the pan, and the hands use a paper towel to rub it across the interior. The pan's dark surface glimmers under the studio lights. The setting remains the kitchen studio. Text explains the technical purpose of the oil film. (7) Fresh olive oil and the egg mixture are poured into the seasoned pan. The liquid spreads across the hot surface, bubbling at the edges. Text advises using more oil for a better aroma during the cooking process. (8) Using a black spatula, the person folds the golden-brown omelet. The camera captures the crispy, browned texture of the egg surface. The background is slightly blurred. Text explains the benefits of the cast iron pan's non-stick film. (9) The omelet is plated on a white oval dish. The person uses a wooden spoon to reveal the juicy, semi-cooked interior. Text describes the flavor profile as 'egg fragrance' and 'scallion sweetness' while highlighting the texture. (10) The main character, a woman with short dark hair in a pink apron, eats a bite of the omelet and gives a thumbs up. Closing text provides social media links for 'Rosalina's Kitchen' on IG, Facebook, and YouTube.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋 養鍋方法 + 煎蔥蛋 示範... (2) [Subtitle]: 準備大約3~4顆雞蛋. (3) [Subtitle]: 把雞蛋打散. (4) [Subtitle]: 切兩三株的蔥花. (5) [Subtitle]: 喜歡多一點就切多一點. (6) [Subtitle]: 放到碗裡... (7) [Subtitle]: 來一小撮鹽調味... (8) [Subtitle]: 攪拌攪拌... (9) [Subtitle]: 養油膜階段... (10) [Subtitle]: 鍋子先用中火預熱3~4分鐘. (11) [Subtitle]: 先讓鍋子有熱度. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後關火一下. (13) [Subtitle]: 加入一大匙的油. (14) [Subtitle]: 用廚房紙巾抹均勻. (15) [Subtitle]: 讓鍋內都沾到油脂 讓鍋子產生一層油膜. (16) [Subtitle]: 接著開中火加熱. (17) [Subtitle]: 大約加熱2分鐘左右 或者看到一點煙冒出來... (18) [Subtitle]: 先關火30秒降溫. (19) [Subtitle]: 油膜養好了! [Variety]: ❤️ (20) [Subtitle]: 再開中火. (21) [Subtitle]: 放入適量的橄欖油 (煎蛋油多一點會比較香). (22) [Subtitle]: 潤一下鍋 加熱約1~2分鐘. (23) [Subtitle]: 放入蛋液... (24) [Subtitle]: 稍微撥動一下確認.. (25) [Subtitle]: 把蛋液都集中在一起... (26) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋的油膜已經形成，就不會沾黏囉！ [Variety]: ❤️ (27) [Subtitle]: 確認底部有沒有焦香... (28) [Subtitle]: 有焦香就可以翻面了. (29) [Subtitle]: 我喜歡蔥蛋表面有焦香，但是裡面是半熟的狀態. (30) [Subtitle]: 會把兩面煎到焦香的樣子. (31) [Subtitle]: 這樣吃起來外面有蛋香 裡面有蛋汁，會很好吃！ 不會乾乾的... (32) [Subtitle]: 這種蔥蛋用鑄鐵鍋煎 特別香！ [Variety]: ❤️❤️ (33) [Subtitle]: 好囉~可以倒出來了. (34) [Subtitle]: 蔥也可以改蒜苗，會更鮮甜！ 我們全家都超愛吃這樣的蔥蛋 [Variety]: ❤️ (35) [Subtitle]: 哇~有蛋汁~ [Variety]: ❤️ (36) [Subtitle]: 蛋香、蔥甜，蛋汁甜 [Variety]: ❤️ (37) [Subtitle]: 超喜歡，讚 [Variety]: ❤️ (38) [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM at 115 BPM. A clear female voice starts the narration in a friendly, professional tone. Distinct percussive clicks and cracks represent eggs breaking into a ceramic bowl during the first phase. (2) The BGM maintains a steady, happy rhythm. Sharp, rhythmic thudding sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board occur as the narrator explains chopping scallions. The voice is mid-pitched with clear articulation, showing high emotional valence and moderate energy. (3) An electronic beep signals the induction stove's activation. This is followed by the dry, rustling sound of a paper towel against the metal pan. The narrator's speech is informative and calm. The BGM provides a consistent and steady melodic background track. (4) A prominent, broadband sizzling sound occurs as the egg mixture hits the hot oil in the pan. The BGM remains energetic throughout. Soft scraping sounds from a spatula are heard as the omelet is folded. The narrator explains the technical cooking process. (5) The sizzling fades as the omelet is served. The narrator's voice becomes more enthusiastic, describing the taste of the finished dish. The BGM concludes with a final upbeat flourish. Background noise is negligible, indicating a high-quality, post-produced studio recording environment.
